items.a: We help businesses, residential communities and fleets plan, supply, install and commission EV charging, from the first site assessment to a working charger.

items.q: Which charger power is right for my site?
items.a: It depends on how long vehicles stay, how many charge at once and the power available at your site. We recommend a configuration after a site assessment.

items.q: Do you handle site assessment and installation?
items.a: Yes. We assess power availability and parking layout, then plan, install and commission the chargers with a documented handover.

items.q: Which vehicles and connectors are supported?
items.a: Our DC fast chargers are specified for the CCS2 connector used by most new electric cars in India. Exact compatibility is confirmed per model.

items.q: How long does a typical project take?
items.a: Timelines depend on site readiness, electrical approvals and charger availability. We share a project plan after the site assessment.
Yes. We work with site hosts and business partners. Share your details and our team will walk you through the available options.
